# SereneGoods

> SereneGoods (https://www.serenegoods.ca) is the web design and development studio of Sanjeev, a web designer and developer based in Durham Region, Ontario, Canada. Sanjeev designs and builds fast, mobile-first websites for businesses and people, with built-in SEO (search engine optimization), AEO (answer engine optimization) and GEO (generative engine optimization). SereneGoods also curates everyday product finds on Amazon Canada.

## Web design and development

- Location: Durham Region, Ontario, Canada
- Service area: Ajax, Pickering, Whitby, Oshawa, Clarington, Uxbridge, Scugog, Brock, the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), and remote clients anywhere
- Services:
  - Business websites: a clear introduction to what a business does, with enquiry and booking forms
  - Portfolios and personal websites: custom designs, not templates
  - Landing pages and website redesigns
  - Search and AI visibility: SEO, AEO (FAQ and structured data for answer boxes and voice assistants) and GEO (llms.txt and entity-rich content so AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity can understand, recommend and cite a business)
  - Custom systems such as a real estate CRM, event ticketing and online tools
- Process: Listen, Design, Build, Launch and support. Clients work directly with Sanjeev from first conversation to launch.
- Contact: hello@serenegoods.ca or the enquiry form at https://www.serenegoods.ca/#contact (replies within two business days)

## Client websites

- [QRforLess](https://qrforless.com): QR code generator with custom colours, logos, and PNG or SVG exports. Includes SEO, AEO and GEO work (FAQ and business schema, llms.txt, sitemap).
- [Anish & Nisarg](https://anishandnisarg.com): Real estate website and CRM system for REALTORS® Anish Gupta and Nisarg Patel. Includes SEO, AEO and GEO work (FAQ and real estate agent schema, llms.txt, sitemap).
- [StaffingPro](https://thestaffingpro.com): Business website for staffing, IT solutions and project delivery services.
- [Cultural Connect Durham](https://ccdevents.ca): Event website for Cultural Connect Durham's Garba nights and tickets.
- [Velvet Ribbons](https://www.velvetribbons.ca): Luxury gift wrapping studio website with occasion collections, corporate gifting and booking enquiries across Durham Region and the GTA.
